steps.observable_result: The current WorkflowHub session has read the portable package and all four current materials, then selected the next pending or in-progress task.
RED evidence demonstrates the intended behavioral change, or tasks.md records why RED is not applicable.
The scoped implementation exists in the task worktree and the actual changed files are recorded in tasks.md.
Every behavior Phase is classified against its actual changed files; an unchanged route is recorded as such and a changed route includes its reason.
The current WorkflowHub session directly uses the selected backend/frontend/fullstack testing package, or records why testing is not applicable for a material-only task.

The concrete testing strategy runs against the real worktree. Declared command/service acceptance scenarios execute through the official handler and private runner, recording per-AC actual/oracle, actor, exit/cancel/cleanup and raw evidence; missing or failed items remain visible instead of inferring acceptance from exit 0.
The current diff is checked for scope and behavior, and the actual findings are recorded in tasks.md.

Each Phase submits a real public review --action=record input.request with subject_kind=phase, phase_id and review_scope=phase; consume returned canonical result/attempt refs, keeping role coverage, provider failures, dispatch/reuse and record errors distinct. Unavailable limits quality claims and permits same-task repair. Use the actual canonical result ref when available; when the review is unavailable, consume its canonical attempt ref. These are alternative evidence paths, not a requirement to produce both.
Every review finding has a disposition in tasks.md; valid findings are repaired before handoff.
The actual implementation and execution facts are current in the task worktree and tasks.md; no parallel implementation record is created.
tasks.md is marked completed only when actual changes, tests, AC evidence, and review dispositions support that claim; missing quality facts stay incomplete but do not block repair.
After all implementation tasks, the recorded final aggregate command runs once and its real exit, coverage limits, and per-AC trace are recorded; this does not claim provider review or pass.

After final tests and per-AC trace, the existing public review request uses subject_kind=worktree, phase_id=null and review_scope=integration. Preserve actual findings and unavailable facts; complete only after current actionable major/blocking findings are resolved, without requiring a provider pass. Use the actual canonical result ref when available; when the review is unavailable, consume its canonical attempt ref. These are alternative evidence paths, not a requirement to produce both.

The existing spec-analyze profile checks the original requirement and all four current materials against the actual implementation, tests, AC trace, review facts, and user-result evidence; valid gaps are repaired in this stage and a plain-language six-field summary is produced before handoff.

The current WorkflowHub session gives a plain-language handoff covering what changed, how it works, final tests and AC trace, integration-review findings, remaining risks, and the next task; the comment is notification, not a gate.
